name: Subscription Notification
description: Sent to subscribers when a scheduled search is run.
subject: [${PRODUCT_NAME}] Subscription: ${searchName}#if (${searchResults.isEmpty()}) (no results)#end
body:
Subscription notification

You are receiving this email because you are subscribed to the search query ${searchName}.

#if (${displayQueryDetails})

The query for this subscription is:

${searchQuery}
#end#if (!${searchResults.isEmpty()})

Here is a summary of the results for this query:

#set ($count = 1)#foreach ($documentType in ${searchResults.keySet()})
${searchResults.get($documentType).get("count")} ${searchResults.get($documentType).get("noun")}#if ($count < ${searchResults.keySet().size()})
#end#set ($count = ${count} + 1)#end #{else}

${searchName} is returning no results at this time.

#end

View results:

  • Run this query in ${PRODUCT_NAME}
  • Download the generated report
#if (${displayQueryDetails} && !${searchResults.isEmpty()})#foreach ($documentType in ${searchResults.keySet()})

${documentType} Results preview#if (${searchResults.get($documentType).get("preview").size()} > 20) (displaying first 20 results)#end:

#set ($isHeader = true)#foreach ($previewRow in ${searchResults.get($documentType).get("preview")}) #foreach ($previewCell in ${previewRow})#if ($isHeader) #{else} #end#end #set ($isHeader = false)#end
${previewCell}${previewCell}
#end#end

If you have questions about this email, contact the subscription owner ${ownerName}.

Thank you,

The ${PRODUCT_NAME} Team

Unsubscribe
